profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ProDIGIQ, Inc.
profile.summary: I’m highly motivated and have a passion for creating and supporting great products. I'm keen to learn and am sharp at identifying and solving problems. I like taking challenges to grow. I break down challenging problems into manageable pieces, working my way through and learning the necessary tools to solve them. And I'm adept at researching and working independently.

company.name: UC San Diego Computer Science and Engineering Department (CSE)

positions.title: CSE Department Tutor
positions.description: Worked with the instructor, Professor Christine Alvarado, to design and write assignments and their specifications. Held office hours to assist students in implementing programming assignments by analyzing and debugging their code. (CSE8A: Java & OOP, CSE95: Tutor apprenticeship, CSE100: Advanced Data Structure in C++)

positions.title: SPIS Academic Project Mentor (SUMMER PROGRAM FOR INCOMING STUDENTS)
positions.description: Tutored incoming Computer Science students in CS fundamentals and assisted them with Web Application projects. (HTML/CSS, JS, Python, Flask)

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher (Immersive Visualization Lab)
positions.description: Designed and developed a real-time application to simulate wearing eyeglasses on display under Professor Jurgen Schulze. Helped my client launch his startup. Published my work at FMP Symposium, UCSD. (Kinect, OpenCV, C++)

company.name: Qualcomm Institute - UCSD Division of Calit2

positions.title: Squad Leader Sergeant
positions.description: Received awards and distinctions for performance in training exercises and drills. Led squad in daily routines and duties with leadership responsibilities. Conducted DMZ security operations as an operator at General Outpost, Dec 2015 - Feb 2016

projects.title: Autonomous Vehicle
projects.description: Built a 1/10 scale autonomous car. Trained a controller by recording images, steering angles, and throttles. Equipped the car with ultrasonic sensor, designed a controller that can park the car autonomously. (Doneky2, Python, Raspberry Pi)

projects.title: Rendering (Game) Engine
projects.description: Developed a game engine application in C++ with OpenGL and Shaders to practice and implement fundamental concepts and algorithms in computer graphics. (OpenGL, C++, Shaders)
